# tuna_ip_policy (Resource)

An IP policy: a named set of allow/deny rules, see tuna_ip_policy_rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tuna_ip_policy" "office" {
  name        = "office-only"
  description = "Allow access from the office network only"
  active      = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the policy.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the policy is enforced. Defaults to true.
- `description` (String) Description of the policy.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import tuna_ip_policy.office 123
```
